name: Emmeline Burns
source:
A young girl living in the early nineteenth century. The daughter of a successful and wealthy family. Has a crush on her friend Cornelia.

[spoiler] When her family went bankrupt, her father Phillip choked her to death and set their house alight. After being resurrected as a ghost, she eventually re-united with Cornelia in the present day.
